text:
anya: Quick brain dump: want a 'SparkDev' micro-launch for community devs — 2 tutorial posts, 1 tiny refapp repo, a 15-min demo livestream, and a single benchmark stat for social. Who takes what?

leo: I can draft the two tutorials: embeddings guide and low-cost chat integration. Will aim for MD + code samples.

rachael: I'll do the refapp (tiny repo with Docker + quickstart). Need perf number to include in README header. @matt can you run the quick sweep?

matt: Yep. Doing a short perf sweep now. Will post p50/p95 and a rough cost per 100k tokens. Using this command: `./perf.sh --model redwood-3b --seq 256 --batch 6`

devrel-bot: Reminder: assets checklist created at https://docs.internal/assets/sparkdev-checklist 🚧

anya: Messaging idea: "Fork, run, and ship: tiny reference apps to get you from prototype to production." Keep it dev-first.

leo: Webinar format: 15-min demo + 10-min chat. Audience: devs who want runnable code. We should capture emails via a one-click repo signup.

rachael: For inbound routing, can we use utm_campaign=sparkdev and route leads to the community list? @matt please confirm webhook payload.

matt: Webhook example I'll use: `curl -X POST https://hooks.example.com/leads -d '{"utm_campaign":"sparkdev","email":"{{email}}"}'` Will set lead_owner to community@redwood.com.

anya: Need hero PNG and 3 tweet-sized copy options by Thu. Rachael, Leo, flag if that timing works.

leo: Works for me.

rachael: Works. Also adding a tiny CONTRIBUTING.md to the refapp repo.

matt: Raw numbers: p50=85ms, p95=160ms on dedicated; cost ~ $95 per 100k tokens (with batching). Use p50 for low-latency callout and cost for README.

anya: Great — I'll draft the launch post and a short dev thread for X. Dropping drafts Wed 11am. Thanks all :rocket:
